title: Boyne Road, Navan, Co. Meath, C15W8X6
seoTitle: Boyne Road, Navan, Co. Meath, C15W8X6
description:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to present to the market a five bedroom feature home situated on a stunning 0.40 acre site located on the prestigious Boyne Road, Navan, Co. Meath. This fabulous home is ideally positioned just 2km from Navan Town and is also within walking distance to many local amenities including schools, shops and sports clubs. The unique layout of this spacious home ensures that the property is provided with an abundance of natural light. 

Accommodation on the ground floor includes a large kitchen / dining area, a beautiful front living room which provides views of both the front and rear garden, a separate sitting room, study, bathroom, double bedroom and a utility. On the first floor there are a further four spacious bedrooms with master ensuite and family bathroom. This family home has been maintained to a high standard by the current owners including significant efficiency upgrade works including a new back boiler, additional insulation and a condensing boiler. This home provides immaculately maintained gardens to both the front and rear of the property. 

Positioned on the highly sought after Boyne Road is a particular highlight of this home. The River Boyne runs to the rear of the property which also provides a leisurely stroll along the ramparts on the banks of the Boyne linking Navan and Slane. Navan is situated on the River Boyne and has expanded considerably over the past two decades due to its proximity to Dublin City Centre (c.45 kms away) and its excellent road infrastructure (M3 motorway).

Viewings via enquiry.
